title: Camellia band lineup on trumpet and years with Paul Barbarin
summary: He lists the Camellia lineup, then recalls about 13 years with Paul Barbarin in the 1930s and a trio with Danny Barker.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Who was in the chameleon band when you came with them? Did they have the same, when you came with them on trumpet, did they have the same line-up? Did they have the same drama, for example? Who was the drama on the bass?
The drama was Alexey Raycart, Raycart's brother.

He's passing now too. And the band was John Smith, George Thompson, which is George Stewart. Albert Fernandez Walters on piano. And string bass, Johnny Prudoff. He was playing with that band too. And Mars Asinor on trombone.
And when you came in, you just took Wood and Joe's play, so?
Who did you play with in the meantime, in between?
Well, I played with so many low bands, you know, gigs, they call them. I played with Paul a while. I played with Paul about 13 years.
Paul Barber, I mean. When was that, that you played with Paul, in the 20s or 30s?
Well, it was about in the 30s, say from 36 until about 47.
Was it you who was telling me about playing with a kazoo player in some little trio?

Yeah, I used to play. That's how I started out on piano too. With Danny Barker, and they had a kazoo player by the name of Joe. Well, he did. We used to play that in a little, in a ballroom at Moran Seminole by Rubion. Well, Danny Barker wasn't playing nothing but ukulele then. He was a devil of a ukulele player then. That's how his uncle had sent for him, brought him to New York to learn banjo.
